blocks.heading: Agile CRM cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Agile CRM against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Free plan capped at 10 users. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
